hard_case: The first two arms of the ladder return the same value, so the test's inputs 100 and 50 give 1 whichever of them the first condition selects. The assertions sit on the changed condition's boundary and look exact, yet no input that separates the rewritten condition from its neighbours changes the result.

reasoning: boxed_units_share_a_class pins handling_class(100) and handling_class(50), both 1. Changing the first arm's value fails it, but moving either threshold or the last arm's value does not, because the first two arms agree: the first condition decides nothing the test can see. Adversarial shape: an exact assertion on the boundary input of a condition whose arms are equal.
